newsitem.title: USA: Chubb Corp Q1 oper share rises.
newsitem.headline: Chubb Corp Q1 oper share rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Net property and casualty premiums written rose 26.1 percent to $1.4 billion from $1.1 billion in the 1996 first quarter. After adjusting for the termination of reinsurance agreements, total premium growth was 11.9 percent. Domestic premiums grew 11.4 percent, international premiums grew 15 percent.
Income from continuing operations, which includes realized investment gains, was $192.1 million, or $1.09 a share, compared with $140.4 million or $0.79 a share a year ago.
Realized investment gains were $0.09 a share compared with $0.07 a share a year ago.
The combined ratio was 96.3 percent compared with 101.3 percent a year ago.
Catastrophe losses totaled $10.4 million in the quarter compared with $73.0 million a year ago.
Property and casualty investment income after taxes rose 8.1 percent to $143.5 million from $132.8 million.
Real estate income after taxes was $1.2 million compared with $4.0 million in 1996.
The company did not provide the average shares outstanding in the first quarter. But the company said it repurchased 5,743,800 shares in the first quarter.

Chubb Capital Corp recently called for the redemption of its six percent exchangeable subordinated notes on May 14, 1997. If the holders of those notes exchange them into shares of Chubb common stock before the redemption date, it would result in the issuance of 5,007,000 shares.
